Sub FBCom_MajClientBTra(p_NoBonCommandeFmt As String, p_BComClientNoFmt As String) ' -------------------------------------------- ' Permet de maj. le client des bons de travail ' -------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_SICl As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc_BTra As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_MajBTra As Boolean
Dim v_NoTravail As String Dim l_ItemsBonTravail List As Variant
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations
Set nd_SICl = xSICl_xndClie(p_BComClientNoFmt, False)
If Not (nd_SICl Is Nothing) Then
Set ndc_BTra = xSIBDT_xndcBTra(p_NoBonCommandeFmt)
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_BTra.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_BTra.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_MajBTra = False
If xVar(nd, "BTra_ClientNoFmt", "") <> p_BComClientNoFmt Then
' Bâtir la liste des champs à modifier l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNoFmt") = p_BComClientNoFmt l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNomInterne") = xVar(nd_SICl, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNom1") = xVar(nd_SICl, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNom2") = xVar(nd_SICl, "Clie_ClientNom2", "") l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNomRecherche") = Evaluate(|@Trim(Clie_ClientNom1 : Clie_ClientNom2 : Clie_ClientNomInterne) |, nd_SICl)
' Si le bon de travail est verrouillé, passer par SI_AgentsTravaux If nd.LockHolders(0) <> "" Then v_NoTravail = SIAT_MajDocument(nd, l_ItemsBonTravail) Print "No travail: " & v_NoTravail & ", maj client bon de travail " & p_BComClientNoFmt Else v_MajBTra = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "BTra_ClientNoFmt", l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNoFmt"), False) v_MajBTra = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "BTra_ClientNomInterne" , l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNomInterne"), False) Or v_MajBTra v_MajBTra = SIIx_MajItem(nd, "BTra_ClientNomRecherche" , l_ItemsBonTravail("BTra_ClientNomRecherche"), False) Or v_MajBTra
If v_MajBTra Then Call nd.Save(True, False) End If End If
End If
loop
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FBCom_CalculerTotalDuree(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Double '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Ce script calcule la durée totale des interventions du bon de commande. ' ' Paramètre: ' pnd_BCom : document du bon de commande ' ' Valeur retournée : durée totale des interventions du bon de commande '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Interventions As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim v_TotalHrsIntervention As Double
' Initialisations FBCom_CalculerTotalDuree = 0 g_BCom_nbInterv_FBCom = 0
' Rechercher toutes les interventions du bon de commande If Not pnd_BCom Is Nothing Then Set ndc_Interventions = pnd_BCom.Responses
If ndc_Interventions Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
If ndc_Interventions.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Nombre d'interventions g_BCom_nbInterv_FBCom = ndc_Interventions.Count
' Boucler sur les interventions Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Interventions.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Interventions.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
' Extraire la durée de l'intervention v_TotalHrsIntervention = v_TotalHrsIntervention + Round(CDbl(xVar(nd,"Inte_Duree",0)) , 2) Loop
' Durée totale des interventions FBCom_CalculerTotalDuree = v_TotalHrsIntervention End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FBCom_PeutModifier(p_Source As NotesUIDocument) As Boolean ' verifier si l'usager à le droit de modifier le bon de commande
On Error Goto GererErreur Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Stat As NotesDocument Dim nv_Stat As NotesView Dim v_Roles As Variant
Call FBCom_Initialisations
FBCom_PeutModifier = False Set nd = p_Source.Document
' Est-ce que l'usager a le rôle Admin? v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) = 1 Then FBCom_PeutModifier = True Exit Function End If
Call xnd("", "BCom_S:" & xVar(nd, "BCom_Statut", "") , False, gndb_FBCom, "V_Stat20", nv_Stat, nd_Stat)
' Si statut est facturé l'usager doit avoir le role [BCom_S90] If xVar(nd, "BCom_Statut", "") = "90" Then v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("| & xVar(nd_Stat, "Stat_Role", "") & |"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) = 1 Then FBCom_PeutModifier = True Exit Function End If Else FBCom_PeutModifier = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FBCom_acAffecter ' ------------------------------------- ' Permet d'affecter le bon de commande. ' ------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim na As NotesAgent Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument
Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Message As String
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations
If Not gnuid_FBCom.EditMode Then gnuid_FBCom.EditMode = True End If
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations If gnuid_FBCom.EditMode Then On Error 4411 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Save On Error 4411 Goto GererErreur End If
' Sortir le DialogBox pour choisir le statut, si necessaire ' --------------------------------------------------------- Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_FBCom)
nd_Box.Form = "DB_Affec" nd_Box.DB_NoPersAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecter",0) nd_Box.DB_NomPersAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom,"BCom_NomPersAffecter","") nd_Box.DB_NomGroupeAffecter= xVar(gnd_FBCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","") nd_Box.DB_CodeGroupeAffecter= xVar(gnd_FBCom,"BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter","")
v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 3, xLangue, "") If gnuiws_FBCom.DialogBox("DB_Affec", True,True,False,False,False,False,_ v_Message, nd_Box,True,False,True) = False Then Exit Sub End If
' Assigner l'affectation ' ---------------------- v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_CommentaireAffectation", "") If Not BCom_AssignerAffectation(gnd_FBCom, nd_Box, v_Commentaire, "") Then Exit Sub End If
'Transfert au dossier(s) de l'employé ou groupe affecté ' ----------------------------------------------------- If Not BCom_TransfertDossierAffectation(gnd_FBCom) Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Error 4005, "Le document n'a pas été transferé au dossier. (" & Cstr(xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "")) & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Rouvrir l'affectation pour mettre à jour l'historique gnd_FBCom.SaveOptions = "0" 'Forcer read mode pour contourner problème de conflit causé par les doc locké gnuid_FBCom.EditMode = False Call gnuid_FBCom.Close
Set na = gndb_FBCom.GetAgent("A_Edit") Call na.Run(gnd_FBCom.NoteId)
%REM gnd_FBCom.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FBCom.Close ' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = gnuiws_FBCom.EditDocument(True, gnd_FBCom) Delete gnuid_FBCom Set gnuid_FBCom= nuid Set gnd_FBCom= gnuid_FBCom.Document Call gnd_FBCom.RemoveItem("SaveOptions")
Call gnuid_FBCom.Save %END REM
finsub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FBCom_acNouvelleRequete
On Error Goto GererErreur
'Genéré si le champ richtext a copier est vide. On Error 4407 Goto ErreurCopie
Dim v_RTVide As Boolean Dim nd_NRequSDS As NotesDocument Dim nd_Requ As NotesDocument Dim nuidoc As NotesUIDocument
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations v_RTVide = False
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations ' ----------------------------------------------------- On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Save On Error 4412 Resume Next
'Si null envoyer à "SI Nouvelle Requête - SDS", sinon envoyer à celui dans le profile. Set nd_NRequSDS = xGDK_xndNDB( xVarProf("Prof_NouvelleRequete", "SI Nouvelle Requête - SDS"),True)
If Not nd_NRequSDS Is Nothing Then
'Copier le contenu du champ rich text Call gnuid_FBCom.GotoField("BCom_DescDetaillee") If gnuid_FBCom.CurrentField = "BCom_DescDetaillee" Then gnuid_FBCom.SelectAll gnuid_FBCom.Copy End If
RTCopie: gnd_FBCom.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FBCom.Close Set nuidoc = gnuiws_FBCom.ComposeDocument( xVar(nd_NRequSDS, "NDB_Serveur", ""), xVar(nd_NRequSDS, "NDB_Fichier", ""), "F_NReq" ) Set nd_Requ = nuidoc.Document
If Not nd_Requ Is Nothing Then
'Le numéro du client nd_Requ.Requ_ClientNo1 = Cstr(xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_ClientNo1", "")) nd_Requ.Requ_ClientNo2 = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_ClientNo2", "")
'Description de la requête Call nuidoc.GoToField("Requ_DescDetaillee") If nuidoc.CurrentField = "Requ_DescDetaillee" Then If xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_DescSommaire", "") <> "" Then Call nuidoc.FieldSetText("Requ_DescDetaillee", xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_DescSommaire", "")) End If 'Faire un paste seulement si le richtexte du document copié n'est pas vide. If v_RTVide = False Then Call nuidoc.FieldAppendText("Requ_DescDetaillee", Chr(10) & Chr(10)) Call nuidoc.Paste End If End If
'Nom et numéro du contact nd_Requ.Requ_NoContact = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoContact", "") nd_Requ.Requ_Contact = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_Contact", "")
'Numéro de téléphone courriel du contact nd_Requ.Requ_ContactTelephone = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_ContactTelephone1_1", "") nd_Requ.Requ_ContactCourriel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_ContactCourriel_1", "")
End If
'Intialise le numéro du bon de commande nd_Requ.Requ_NoBonCommandeFmt = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
ErreurCopie: v_RTVide = True Resume RTCopie
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

On Error 4412 Resume Next Call gnuid_FBCom.Refresh End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FBCom_PostOpen(p_Source As NotesUIDocument) '=========================================== ' Postopen du formulaire de Bons de commande '=========================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set nd = p_Source.Document
Call FBCom_Initialisations Call Initialisation_xSICT Call Initialisation_xTabl
g_BCom_AutreContactFonction = xVar(nd, "BCom_AutreContactFonction", "")
g_ClientFacturation = xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") If g_ClientFacturation = "" Then ' ClientFacturation : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays g_ClientFacturation = xVar(nd, "BCom_FactNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactVille", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactPays", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactTablePays", "") End If
g_ClientLivraison = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") If g_ClientLivraison = "" Then ' ClientLivraison : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays g_ClientLivraison = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrVille", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrPays", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrTablePays", "") End If
If xVar(nd, "BCom_SaisirAdresse", "") = "L" Then g_ClientBComNoFmt = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") Else g_ClientBComNoFmt = xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") End If
' Durée des interventions nd.BCom_DureeInterventions = FBCom_CalculerTotalDuree(nd) nd.BCom_NbInterventions = g_BCom_nbInterv_FBCom nd.BCom_DureeTotal = xVar(nd, "BCom_Duree", 0) + xVar(nd, "BCom_DureeInterventions", 0)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FBCom_hsSelectionnerConseiller ' ------------------------------------- ' Permet de sélectionner le conseiller. ' ------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Emp As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Emp As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_ServeurEm As String Dim v_FichierEm As String Dim v_BCom_NomConseiller As String Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim i As Integer
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations
v_ServeurEm = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "SF_ServeurSIEm", gndb_FBCom.Server) v_FichierEm = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "SF_FichierSIEm", "")
'nom du conseiller présentement dans le document v_BCom_NomConseiller = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NomConseiller", "")
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur
' Afficher la liste des employés Set ndc_Emp = gnuiws_FBCom.PickListCollection( PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, v_ServeurEm, v_FichierEm,_ "V_Empl27", "Employés", "Choisir un employé")
If ndc_Emp.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
' Assigner le conseiller au document ' ---------------------------------- Set nd_Emp = ndc_Emp.GetFirstDocument If Not BCom_AssignerConseiller(gnd_FBCom, nd_Emp) Then Exit Sub End If
' Transfert au dossier du conseiller ' ---------------------------------- If Not BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller(gnd_FBCom) Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Error 4005, "Le document n'a pas été transferé au dossier. (" & CStr(xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "")) & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Ajouter le commentaire à l'historique ' ------------------------------------- If Not gnd_FBCom.IsNewNote Then If SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FBCom, "" ,"Action nouveau conseiller : " & v_BCom_NomConseiller & " --> " & xVar( nd_Emp, "Empl_NomEmploye", ""), "", False) Then ' Accepter le bon de commande If SIHi_BatirHistorique(gnd_FBCom) Then ' Rouvrir le document en édition gnd_FBCom.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FBCom.Close Set nuid =gnuiws_FBCom.EditDocument(True, gnd_FBCom) Delete gnuid_FBCom Set gnuid_FBCom= nuid Set gnd_FBCom = gnuid_FBCom.Document Call gnd_FBCom.RemoveItem("SaveOptions") End If End If End If
' fait un save & "refresh" du doc If Not gnuid_FBCom.EditMode Then gnuid_FBCom.EditMode = True End If
Call gnuid_FBCom.Save
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FBCom_QuerySave(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_ContactFonction As NotesDocument Dim v_AliasContactFonction As Variant Dim v_Complement1ContactFonction As Variant Dim v_Pos As Variant Dim v_ClientFacturation As String Dim v_ClientLivraison As String Dim v_MajClientBTra As Boolean
FBCom_QuerySave = False
' Initialisations Set nd = pnuid_Source.Document
' Rafraichir le document ' ---------------------- ' Document locké par un autre utilisateur On Error 4407 Goto FinSub
On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call pnuid_Source.Refresh On Error 4412 Resume Next
' Valider le client ' ------------------------ If xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") = "" And xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNom", "") = "" Then Messagebox "Le client est obligatoire.", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 0, "", "") Call pnuid_Source.GotoField("BCom_ClientNo1") Exit Function End If
If xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientOccasionnel", False) = 1 And xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNom", "") = "" Then Messagebox "Le nom du client est obligatoire.", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 0, "", "") Call pnuid_Source.GotoField("BCom_ClientNom") Exit Function End If
' Numéro du bon de commande ' ---------------------------------------------- If xVar(nd, "BCom_NoBonCommande", 0) = 0 Then nd.BCom_NoBonCommande = BCom_NoBonCommande End If
If xVar(nd, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") = "" Then If xVar(nd, "BCom_NoBonCommande", 0) <> 0 Then nd.BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt = "B" & Format(xVar(nd, "BCom_NoBonCommande", 0), "000000") & "-" & xVar(nd, "BCom_NoSite", "00") End If End If
'Créer la demande de création dans Projeto pour autre contact Set nd_ContactFonction = xGDK_xndTabl("Cont_Fonctions" & xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientCategorie", "") & xVar(nd, "BCom_Langue", "FR") , True) If Not nd_ContactFonction Is Nothing Then v_AliasContactFonction = xVar(nd_ContactFonction, "Tabl_Valeurs", "") v_Complement1ContactFonction = xVar(nd_ContactFonction, "Tabl_Complement1", "") v_Pos = Arraygetindex(v_AliasContactFonction, xVar(nd, "BCom_AutreContactFonction", "")) End If If xVar(nd, "BCom_AutreContactFonction", "") <> g_BCom_AutreContactFonction Then If Not Isnull(v_Pos) Then If Isarray( v_Complement1ContactFonction) Then If v_Complement1ContactFonction(v_Pos) = "1" And xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientCategorie", "") = "SDS" Then Call PJCo_Initialisations Call PJCo_SoumettreDDC(nd) End If End If End If g_BCom_AutreContactFonction = pnuid_Source.FieldGetText("BCom_AutreContactFonction") End If
v_ClientFacturation = xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientFacturation = "" Then ' ClientFacturation : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays v_ClientFacturation = xVar(nd, "BCom_FactNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactVille", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactPays", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_FactTablePays", "") End If
v_ClientLivraison = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientLivraison = "" Then ' ClientLivraison : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays v_ClientLivraison = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrVille", "") & ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrPays", "") &";" & xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrTablePays", "") End If
If g_ClientFacturation <> v_ClientFacturation Then g_ClientFacturation = v_ClientFacturation End If
If g_ClientLivraison <> v_ClientLivraison Then g_ClientLivraison = v_ClientLivraison End If
v_MajClientBTra = False
If xVar(nd, "BCom_SaisirAdresse", "") = "L" Then If g_ClientBComNoFmt <> xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") Then g_ClientBComNoFmt = xVar(nd, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") v_MajClientBTra = True End If Else If g_ClientBComNoFmt <> xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") Then g_ClientBComNoFmt = xVar(nd, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") v_MajClientBTra = True End If End If
' Si le no de client modifié maj. le clients des bons de travail If v_MajClientBTra Then Call FBCom_MajClientBTra(xVar(nd, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", ""), g_ClientBComNoFmt) End If
If pnuid_Source.IsNewDoc = True Then nd.BCom_EnvoyerCourriel = "1" ' Envoyer le courriel d'avis si nouveau bon de commande End If
Call BCom_AssignerAuteurs(nd)
FBCom_QuerySave = True
FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FBCom_acCreerBonTravail ' ----------------------------------------- ' Permet de créer un nouveau bon de travail ' ----------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_BTra As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientFacturation As String Dim v_ClientLivraison As String Dim v_Message As String Dim v_NoteID As String Dim ws_BonTravail As Cl_wsBonTravail Dim v_NoBonCommande As String
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations Call xSIBDT_Initialisations
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Refresh On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
v_ClientFacturation = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientFacturation = "" Then ' ClientFacturation : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays v_ClientFacturation = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactVille", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactPays", "") &";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_FactTablePays", "") End If
v_ClientLivraison = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientLivraison = "" Then ' ClientLivraison : No client ou array nom1;nom2;adresse1;adresse2;ville;province;codepostal;pays v_ClientLivraison = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrNom1", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrNom2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrAdresse1", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrAdresse2", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrVille", "") & ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrProvince", "") & _ ";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrCodePostal", "") &";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrPays", "") &";" & xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_LivrTablePays", "") End If
If v_Message = "" Then If (v_ClientFacturation <> g_ClientFacturation And v_ClientLivraison <> g_ClientLivraison) Then v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 19, "", "facturation et livraison") End If End If If v_Message = "" Then If v_ClientFacturation <> g_ClientFacturation Then v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 19, "", "facturation") End If End If If v_Message = "" Then If v_ClientLivraison <> g_ClientLivraison Then v_Message = xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 19, "", "livraison") End If End If
If v_Message <> "" Then If gnuiws_FBCom.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Confirmation", v_Message) Then If gnuid_FBCom.EditMode Then On Error 4411 Goto FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Save On Error 4411 Goto GererErreur End If End If End If
v_NoBonCommande = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFMT", "") Set ws_BonTravail = New Cl_wsbontravail v_NoteID = ws_BonTravail.Creerbontravail("SIBDC2", v_NoBonCommande, gns_FBCom.UserName, "00") ' Via WebServices If v_NoteID <> "" Then Set nd_BTra = gndb_xSIBDT.GetDocumentById(v_NoteID) End If
If Not nd_BTra Is Nothing Then nd_Btra.Temp_IsNewDoc = 1 nd_Btra.BTra_DescSommaire = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_DescSommaire", "") Call gnuiws_FBCom.EditDocument(True, nd_BTra) On Error 4412 Resume Next
Call gnuid_FBCom.Refresh End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FBCom_BatirHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument, pnvec As NotesViewEntryCollection) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script ajoute une ligne à l'historique du document. '------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nrtps(1 To 3) As NotesRichTextParagraphStyle Dim nco As NotesColorObject Dim ncoAlt As NotesColorObject Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrts As NotesRichTextStyle Dim nrtn As NotesRichTextNavigator Dim nrtt As NotesRichTextTable Dim ni As NotesItem Dim nve As NotesViewEntry Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Cellule As Long Dim i As Long Dim v_NomItemUser As Variant Dim v_NbFichiers As Variant Dim v_NomFichiers As Variant Dim v_Fichiers As String
FBCom_BatirHistorique = False
' Initialisations ' --------------- Call FBCom_Initialisations Set nrtps(1) = gns_FBCom.CreateRichTextParagraphStyle nrtps(1).LeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(1).FirstLineLeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(1).RightMargin = 1.8 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER Set nrtps(2) = gns_FBCom.CreateRichTextParagraphStyle nrtps(2).LeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(2).FirstLineLeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(2).RightMargin = 3.45 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER Set nrtps(3) = gns_FBCom.CreateRichTextParagraphStyle nrtps(3).LeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(3).FirstLineLeftMargin = 0.199 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER nrtps(3).RightMargin = 18.995 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER Set nco = gns_FBCom.CreateColorObject nco.NotesColor = COLOR_WHITE Set ncoAlt = gns_FBCom.CreateColorObject Call ncoAlt.SetRGB(230, 239, 244) ' Créer le nouvel item de l'historique ' ------------------------------------ Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(pnd, "JoIn_Historique") Set nrts = gns_FBCom.CreateRichTextStyle nrts.NotesFont = nrti.GetNotesFont("Default Sans Serif", True) nrts.FontSize = 8 nrts.Bold = False Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts)
' Créer le tableau d'affichage de l'historique ' -------------------------------------------- Set nrtn = nrti.CreateNavigator Call nrti.AppendTable(pnvec.Count + 1, _ 3, "", 2.54 * RULER_ONE_CENTIMETER, nrtps) Call nrtn.FindFirstElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablE) Set nrtt = nrtn.GetElement nrtt.Style = TABLESTYLE_ALTERNATINGROWS Call nrtt.SetColor(ncoAlt) Call nrtt.SetAlternateColor(nco)
' Afficher les titres v_Cellule = 0 v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText("Date") Call nrti.EndInsert
v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText("Nom") Call nrti.EndInsert
v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText("Description") Call nrti.EndInsert
' Boucler sur toutes les lignes d'historique à afficher ' ----------------------------------------------------- Set nve = pnvec.GetFirstEntry Do Until nve Is Nothing Set nd = nve.Document
' Ajouter la date dans la première colonne ' ---------------------------------------- v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText(Format(xVar(nd, "HistoDC", ""), "yyyy/mm/dd")) Call nrti.EndInsert
' Ajouter l'utilisateur dans la deuxième colonne ' ---------------------------------------------- v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) v_NomItemUser = Evaluate( { @Name([CN]; "} & xVar(nd, "HistoUC", "") & {")}) Call nrti.AppendText(v_NomItemUser(0)) Call nrti.EndInsert
' Ajouter la description dans une troisième colonne ' ------------------------------------------------- ' (incluant fichiers, si necessaire) v_Fichiers = "" v_NbFichiers = Evaluate({@Attachments}, nd) If v_NbFichiers(0) > 0 Then v_NomFichiers = Evaluate({@Implode(@AttachmentNames; "; ")}, nd) v_Fichiers = Cstr( v_NbFichiers(0)) & " pièces jointes : " & v_NomFichiers(0) End If
v_Cellule = v_Cellule + 1 Call nrtn.FindNthElement(RTELEM_TYPE_TablECELL, v_Cellule) Call nrti.BeginInsert(nrtn) nrts.NotesColor = COLOR_DARK_RED Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText(xVar(nd, "Inte_Sommaire", "")) Call nrti.AddNewline(1) nrts.NotesColor = COLOR_BLACK Call nrti.AppendStyle(nrts) Call nrti.AppendText(xVar(nd, "Inte_Details", "")) If v_Fichiers <> "" Then Call nrti.AddNewline(2) Call nrti.AppendText( v_FIchiers) End If Call nrti.EndInsert
Set nve = pnvec.GetNextEntry(nve) Loop
FBCom_BatirHistorique = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FBCom_updateRTitem(newdoc As NotesDocument,refdoc As NotesDocument,rtName As String, newName As String) ' ------------------- ' Copier un rich text ' ------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim srcRTitem As NotesRichTextItem Set srcRTitem = refdoc.Getfirstitem(rtName) Dim nav As NotesRichTextNavigator
Dim tmpRTitem As NotesRichTextItem Set tmpRTitem = newdoc.Getfirstitem(newName)
If tmpRTitem Is Nothing Then Set tmpRTitem = New NotesRichTextItem(newdoc,newName) End If
If Not srcRTitem Is Nothing Then Call tmpRTitem.AppendRTItem(srcRTitem) Call tmpRTitem.Update() End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FBCom, gc_Element_FBCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FBCom_acChangerStatut On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim na As NotesAgent Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim a_NoBonsTravail As Variant Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Affecter As Boolean Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_StatutProp As String
' Initialisations Call FBCom_Initialisations
' Sauvegarder le document ' ----------------------- If gnuid_FBCom.EditMode Then On Error 4411 GoTo FinSub On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FBCom.Save On Error 4411 Resume Next On Error 4412 Resume Next End If
' Demander le nouveau statut ' -------------------------- Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_FBCom) nd_Box.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_Box.DB_TableStatuts = gc_NomTableStatut_FBCom & xLangue nd_Box.DB_StatutActuel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_Statut", "") nd_Box.DB_NoFacture = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoFacture", "") nd_Box.DB_Origine = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_Origine", "") nd_Box.DB_NoPersAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecter", 0) nd_Box.DB_NomPersAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NomPersAffecter", "") nd_Box.DB_NoPersAffecterActuel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecter", 0) nd_Box.DB_NomPersAffecterActuel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NomPersAffecter", "") nd_Box.DB_NomGroupeAffecterActuel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") nd_Box.DB_CodeGroupeAffecterActuel = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter", "") nd_Box.DB_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") nd_Box.DB_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter", "")
If Not gnuiws_FBCom.DialogBox("DB_Stat", True, True, False, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 97, xLangue, ""), nd_Box, _ True, False, False) Then Exit Sub End If
gnd_FBCom.BCom_NoFacture = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_NoFacture", "")
v_Statut = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Statut", "") v_Origine = xVar(gnd_FBCom, "BCom_Origine", "")
'Validation 'Si 90-Facturé If v_Statut = "90" Or v_Statut = "95" Then 'If Not SDSBT_ValiderBonsTravailTousFacture(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail) Then If Not SDSBT_ValiderStatutBonsTravail(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail, "92") Then
If IsArray(a_NoBonsTravail) Then
' Impossible de mettre le statut du bon de commande à xxx car le(s) bon(s) de travail suivant(s) ne sont pas facturé : yyy Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FBCom) nd_DB.DB_Message = xGDK_xMessage ("SIBDC", 23, "", xDescTabl(v_Statut, "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, True)) nd_DB.DB_BonsTravail = a_NoBonsTravail Call gnuiws_FBCom.Dialogbox("DB_LBT", True, True, True, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, False)
Exit Sub End If
End If End If
If v_Statut = "69" Then 'If Not SDSBT_ValiderBonsTravailFacture(gnd_FBCom) Then If Not SDSBT_ValiderStatutBonsTravail(gnd_FBCom, "", "69") Then 'Impossible de mettre le statut du bon de commande à XXX parce qu'aucun des bons de travail n'ont été complétés. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 24, "", xDescTabl(v_Statut, "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, True)), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If End If
If v_Statut = "70" Then 'If Not SDSBT_ValiderBonsTravailAFacturer(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail) Then If Not SDSBT_ValiderStatutBonsTravail(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail, v_Statut) Then If IsArray(a_NoBonsTravail) Then ' Impossible de mettre le statut du bon de commande à xxx car le(s) bon(s) de travail suivant(s) ne sont pas completés : yyy Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FBCom) nd_DB.DB_Message = xGDK_xMessage ("SIBDC", 25, "", xDescTabl(v_Statut, "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, True)) nd_DB.DB_BonsTravail = a_NoBonsTravail Call gnuiws_FBCom.Dialogbox("DB_LBT", True, True, True, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, False) Exit Sub End If End If End If
If v_Statut = "80" Then If Not SDSBT_ValiderStatutBonsTravail(gnd_FBCom, "", "80") Then 'Impossible de mettre le statut du bon de commande à XXX parce qu'aucun des bons de travail n'ont été facturés. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 27, "", xDescTabl(v_Statut, "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, True)), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If End If
If v_Statut = "99" Then
'If Not SDSBT_ValiderBonsTravailTousAnnule(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail) Then If Not SDSBT_ValiderStatutBonsTravail(gnd_FBCom, a_NoBonsTravail, v_Statut) Then If IsArray(a_NoBonsTravail) Then

Exit Sub End If End If End If

Call FBCom_MajStatutProp(v_Statut)
If v_Origine = "SDSPP" Or v_Origine = "SDSP3" Then v_StatutProp = BCom_StatutProposition(gnd_FBCom) If v_StatutProp = "95" Then Call BCom_AssignerStatut(gnd_FBCom, "95", "", "", False) Call BCCC_AssignerStatutProp(gnd_FBCom, "92", "", "") End If End If

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SIBDC2" ou "SIBDC2" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SIBDC2" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "BCom" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSIBDC2 As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SIBDC2 As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSIBDC2 As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSIBDC2 As Notesdocument Dim gnv_BCom_xSIBDC2 As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_BCom_xSIBDC2 As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_BCom25_xSIBDC2 As NotesView

Const gc_NomItemCleBCom_xSIBDC2 = "BCom_NoBonCommandeFMT" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomItemCleBComSeq_xSIBDC2 = "BCom_NoBonCommande" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomItemCleBComOrig_xSIBDC2 = "BCom_Origine" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueBCom_xSIBDC2 = "V_BCom20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueBComSeq_xSIBDC2 = "V_BCom24" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueBComOrig_xSIBDC2 = "V_BCom25" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSIBDC2_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil de la base de documents.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSIBDC2_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de profil If gnd_Prof_SIBDC2 Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_SIBDC2 = gndb_xSIBDC2.Getprofiledocument("F_Prof") End If
If gnd_Prof_SIBDC2 Is Nothing Then xSIBDC2_xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Else xSIBDC2_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_SIBDC2, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End If End Function

Function xSIBDC2_xComplTabl(ByVal p_Cle As String, ByVal p_Table As String, ByVal p_NoComplement As String, _ ByVal p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSIBDC2_xComplTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSIBDC2_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSIBDC2_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement, "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If IsArray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = LBound(v_Valeurs) To UBound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= LBound(v_Descriptions) And i <= UBound(v_Descriptions) Then xSIBDC2_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If IsArray(v_Descriptions) Then xSIBDC2_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSIBDC2_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Option Public Option Declare
Use "BC_Dossier" Use "SDS_Propositions2" Use "SDS_Propositions3" Use "SI_CompteurSequentiel" Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SI_Historique" Use "SI_Insertions" Use "x_SIBDC2" Use "x_Tabl" Use "x_SIRR" Use "x_SICl" Use "x_SICo" Use "SI_Temp" Use "wsc_BonTravail"

Dim gns_BCom As NotesSession Dim gndb_BCom As NotesDatabase
Dim g_CheminDossier_A As String
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_BCom = "SL" Const gc_Element_BCom = "BC_BonCommande"

Function BCom_ChangerStatutProposition(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_NouvStatutProp As String, p_UserName As String, p_Commentaire As String) As Integer On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Prop As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument
Dim v_OrigineCle As String Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_Unid As String Dim v_StatutProp As String
Const c_NomTableStatut = "BCom_Statut"
v_OrigineCle = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_OrigineCle", "") ' Numéro de proposition v_Origine = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_Origine", "") ' SDSP3 ou SDSPP ou autre
BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = 0
If p_NouvStatutProp = "0" Or _ p_NouvStatutProp = "" Then ' Pas de mise à jour BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = 1 Exit Function End If
Set nd_DB = SITp_ndTemp("SIBDC2.acChangerStatut") nd_DB.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_DB.DB_Commentaire = p_Commentaire
Call nd_DB.Save(True, False) v_Unid = nd_DB.UniversalId
If Not Isnull(v_OrigineCle) Then
Select Case v_Origine
Case "SDSP3" Set nd_Prop = xSDSP3_xndProp(v_OrigineCle, True)
v_StatutProp = xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_Statut","")
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then If v_StatutProp <> p_NouvStatutProp Then %REM PBE 2021-08-27 Permettre au statut de passer de 95 à 90 If p_NouvStatutProp = "90" Or p_NouvStatutProp = "95" Then ' Si commission payé ne pas maj. la proposition If v_StatutProp = "95" Then ' Pas de mise à jour BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = 1 Exit Function End If End If %end rem If Not SDSP3_ChangerStatut(nd_Prop, p_NouvStatutProp, p_UserName, v_Unid) Then BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = -1 Exit Function End if End If End If
Case "SDSPP" Set nd_Prop = xSDSPP_xndProp(v_OrigineCle, True)
v_StatutProp = xVar(nd_Prop, "Prop_Statut","")
If Not nd_Prop Is Nothing Then If v_StatutProp <> p_NouvStatutProp Then %rem If p_NouvStatutProp = "90" Or p_NouvStatutProp = "95" Then ' Si commission payé ne pas maj. la proposition If v_StatutProp = "95" Then ' Pas de mise à jour BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = 1 Exit Function End If End If %end rem If Not SDSPP_ChangerStatut(nd_Prop, p_NouvStatutProp, p_UserName, v_Unid) Then BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = -1 Exit Function End If End if End If
Case Else BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = -2 End Select
End If Exit Function
GererErreur: BCom_ChangerStatutProposition = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_AssignerConseiller(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, pnd_Emp As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le bon de commande au conseiller sélectionné. ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' pnd_Emp ---> Document. Le document du nouveau conseiller ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
BCom_AssignerConseiller = False
'si selectionne le même conseiller ne met pas a jour le document If xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoConseiller", 0) = xVar(pnd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0) Then Exit Function End If
' Ajouter le # d'employé pnd_BCom.BCom_NoConseillerInitial = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoConseiller", 0) pnd_BCom.BCom_NoConseiller = xVar(pnd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0)
BCom_AssignerConseiller = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant, pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de retirer le bon de commande de tous les dossiers des membres du groupe 'Paramètre: ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le bon de commande sélectionné . '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim V_Grou40 As notesview Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant
' Initialisations '---------------- Call BCDo_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecter",0)
BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = "" Or _ v_NomGroupeAffecter = v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then Exit Function End If
If Isarray(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then
' Ne pas retourner de message d'erreur si groupe membres vide If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial)) = "" Then BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = True Exit Function End If
If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial)) <> "" Then ' Retirer le bon de commande des anciens dossiers Forall EmpNo In pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial
BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = True
If Isarray(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then
If Isnull(Arraygetindex(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe, Cstr(EmpNo))) Then ' Ne pas retiré du dossier si employé dans nouvelle groupe d'affectation If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then
Call BCDo_InfoDossier(Cstr(EmpNo),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False End If End If
Else If Cstr(EmpNo) <> Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter) Then If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial, Cstr(EmpNo))) Then If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then
Call BCDo_InfoDossier(Cstr(EmpNo),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If End If End If
End Forall
End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

g_CheminDossier_A = Environ("Temp") & "\sibdc" End If

Function BCom_AssignerAffectation(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, pnd_Box As NotesDocument, p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'assigner l'affectation du bon de commande ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomPersAffecter As String Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoPersAffecterInitial As Integer Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial As String Dim v_CodeGroupeAffecter As String
BCom_AssignerAffectation= False
v_NoPersAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",0) v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
'assignation interactif If xVar(pnd_Box, "Form", "") = "DB_Stat" Or xVar(pnd_Box, "Form", "") = "DB_Affec" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("BCom_AssignerAffectation : ...2",0,0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog v_NomPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NomPersAffecter","") v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NoPersAffecter",0) v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_CodeGroupeAffecter","") 'assignation programation ElseIf xVar(pnd_Box, "Form", "") = "F_Stat" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("BCom_AssignerAffectation : ...2",0,0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog v_NomPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box, "Stat_NomIntervenantDefaut" , "") v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box, "Stat_NoIntervenantDefaut",0) v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box, "Stat_NomGroupeIntervenantDefaut", "") v_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box, "Stat_CodeGroupeIntervenantDefaut" , "") End If
'Assigner le affectation ' ----------------------
'Affecter à employé If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NomPersAffecter <> "" Then If Not BCom_AffecterEmploye(pnd_BCom, v_NomPersAffecter, v_NoPersAffecter, p_Commentaire, p_UserName) Then Exit Function End If 'Affecter à un groupe ElseIf v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("BCom_AffecterGroupe : début..." ,0,0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog If Not BCom_AffecterGroupe(pnd_BCom, v_NomGroupeAffecter, v_CodeGroupeAffecter , p_Commentaire, p_Username) Then Exit Function End If End If
' Affecter à null (retirer l'affectation) If v_NoPersAffecter = 0 And v_NomPersAffecter = "" And v_NoPersAffecterInitial <> 0 And v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" Then If Not BCom_RetirerAffectationEmploye(pnd_BCom, xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",""), p_Commentaire, p_Username) Then Exit Function End If Elseif v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial <> "" Then If Not BCom_RetirerAffectationGroupe(pnd_BCom, xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial",""), p_Commentaire, p_Username) Then Exit Function End If End If
BCom_AssignerAffectation = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_AffecterGroupe(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_NomGroupeAffecter As String, p_CodeGroupeAffecter As String, _ p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'affecter le bon de commande à un groupe ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' p_NomGroupeAffecter ---> String. Le nom du groupe affecté au bon de commande ' p_Commentaire ---> String. Le commentaire saisi par l'utilisateur. ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 4294 Resume Next ' Unable to send mail, no match found in Name & Address Book(s)
Dim v_SendTo As String Dim v_NomPersAffecterInitial As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem
BCom_AffecterGroupe = False
' Veifier si l'affectation va changer ' ------------------------------------ If p_NomGroupeAffecter = "" Or p_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") Then Exit Function End If
' Initialisations Call BCom_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_BCom.UserName End If
v_NomPersAffecterInitial = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",0), "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True))
' Assigner commentaire If xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") = "" Then
If v_NomPersAffecterInitial <> "" Then v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & v_NomPersAffecterInitial & " --> " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter", "") & " --> " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If
'Assigner le affectation ' ---------------------- pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecter = p_NomGroupeAffecter pnd_BCom.BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter = p_CodeGroupeAffecter pnd_BCom.BCom_NoPersAffecter= 0 pnd_BCom.BCom_NomPersAffecter= ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_BCom, "" ,v_Commentaire, p_UserName, False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le bon de commande If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_BCom) Then
' Envoyer le courriel au groupe concerné v_SendTo = BCom_FormatterNomGroupe(p_NomGroupeAffecter)
If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BCom.BCom_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_BCom)
nd_Temp.Temp_Client = Evaluate({@If(@IsNull(BCom_ClientNoFmt) | BCom_ClientOccasionnel; BCom_ClientNom; @Trim(BCom_ClientNom1 + " " + BCom_ClientNom2) + " (" + BCom_ClientNoFmt + ")")}, pnd_BCom) nd_Temp.BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") nd_Temp.BCom_NomPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomPersAffecter", "") nd_Temp.BCom_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") nd_Temp.Temp_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutCommentaires = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutCommentaires", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutDescFR = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutDescFR", "")
' Construire le courriel Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_Temp, "A_WFBCom_NaGrou", "FR", v_SendTo, "", "", 0, "")
' Ajouter le lien vers l'affectation Set nrti = nd_Courriel.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.AppendDocLink(pnd_BCom, "Bon de commande")
' Envoyer le courriel ' Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom) ' Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Envoie courriel groupe d'affectation :" & v_SendTo ,0,0, False) ' Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Call nd_Courriel.Send(False)
Else Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), 0, _ "Le destinataire du courriel est vide." , "", True) End If
BCom_AffecterGroupe = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub BCom_CreerIntervention(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_DescSommaire As String) On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 75 Resume Next ' Kill : Si le fichier n'existe pas --> OK
Dim nd_Inte As NotesDocument Dim v_NoBonCommandeFmt As String Dim ni As NotesItem Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nrti_Inte As NotesRichTextItem Dim s As String
' Initialisations Call BCom_Initialisations v_NoBonCommandeFmt = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "")
Set nd_Inte = New NotesDocument(gndb_BCom)
nd_Inte.Form = "F_Inte" nd_Inte.BCom_NoBonCommande = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommande", 0) nd_Inte.BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt = v_NoBonCommandeFmt nd_Inte.Cle = v_NoBonCommandeFmt nd_Inte.Description = "Intervention - " & CStr(v_NoBonCommandeFmt) nd_Inte.Icone = 41 nd_Inte.Inte_Sommaire = p_DescSommaire nd_Inte.UNIDParent = CStr(pnd_BCom.UniversalID)
Set nrti = pnd_BCom.Getfirstitem("BCom_DescDetaillee") Set nrti_Inte = New NotesRichTextItem(nd_Inte, "Inte_Details")
If IsArray(nrti.EmbeddedObjects) Then ForAll neo In nrti.EmbeddedObjects s = g_CheminDossier_A & "\" & neo.Source MkDir g_CheminDossier_A Kill s Call neo.Extractfile(s)
If s <> "" Then Call nrti_Inte.EmbedObject(EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", s, "BonCommande") End If
End Forall End If
Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_Inte, "Auteur", gns_BCom.UserName, AUTHORS) Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_Inte, "AuteurAdmin", "[Admin]", AUTHORS)
nd_Inte.HistoDC = Now nd_Inte.HistoUC = gns_BCom.UserName
Call nd_Inte.MakeResponse(pnd_BCom) Call nd_Inte.Save(True, False)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function BCom_StatutProposition(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_OrigineCle As String Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_StatutProp As String
v_OrigineCle = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_OrigineCle", "") ' Numéro de proposition v_Origine = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_Origine", "") ' SDSP3 ou SDSPP ou autre
If Not IsNull(v_OrigineCle) Then
Select Case v_Origine Case "SDSP3" v_StatutProp = xSDSP3_xVarProp(v_OrigineCle, "Prop_Statut", "", False) Case "SDSPP" v_StatutProp = xSDSPP_xVarProp(v_OrigineCle, "Prop_Statut", "", False) End Select
End if
BCom_StatutProposition = v_StatutProp
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_CalculerStatutProposition(p_OrigineCle As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Formule As String Dim l_cleStatutBCom As Variant Dim l_cleStatutBCom_Min As Variant Dim l_cleStatutBCom_Max As Variant Dim v_NouvStatutProp As String
BCom_CalculerStatutProposition = "0"

l_cleStatutBCom = Evaluate(v_Formule)
If Not IsArray(l_cleStatutBCom) Then Exit Function End If

v_NouvStatutProp = xComplTabl(l_cleStatutBCom_Min(0), "BCom_Statut" & xLangue, "1", True) BCom_CalculerStatutProposition = v_NouvStatutProp

Function BCom_RetirerAffectationEmploye(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_NoPersAffecter As Integer, _ p_Commentaire As String, p_Username As String) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retirer l'employé affecté au bon de commande ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' p_NoPersAffecter ---> String. Le no de l'employé affecté au bon de commande ' p_Commentaire ---> String. Le commentaire saisi par l'utilisateur. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur Dim v_NomPersAffecterInitial As String Dim v_SendTo As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem
BCom_RetirerAffectationEmploye = False
' Initialisations Call BCom_Initialisations
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_BCom.UserName End If
v_NomPersAffecterInitial = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",0), "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True)) 'Assigner commentaire v_Commentaire = "Action affectation retiré : " & v_NomPersAffecterInitial & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire
'Assigner le affectation ' ---------------------- pnd_BCom.BCom_NoPersAffecter= 0 pnd_BCom.BCom_NomPersAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_BCom, "" ,v_Commentaire, p_UserName, False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le bon de commande If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_BCom) Then
' Envoyer le courriel aux personnes concernées v_SendTo = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoPersAffecter, "Empl_NotesId", 0, True)) If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BCom.BCom_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_BCom)
nd_Temp.Temp_Client = Evaluate({@If(@IsNull(BCom_ClientNoFmt) | BCom_ClientOccasionnel; BCom_ClientNom; @Trim(BCom_ClientNom1 + " " + BCom_ClientNom2) + " (" + BCom_ClientNoFmt + ")")}, pnd_BCom) nd_Temp.BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutCommentaires = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutCommentaires", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutDescFR = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutDescFR", "")
' Construire le courriel Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_Temp, "A_WFBCom_R", "FR", v_SendTo, "", "", 0, "")
' Ajouter le lien vers l'affectation Set nrti = nd_Courriel.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.AppendDocLink(pnd_BCom, "Bon de commande")
' Envoyer le courriel If Instr(Lcase(gndb_BCom.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement nd_Courriel.SendTo = gns_BCom.UserName nd_Courriel.CopyTo = "" Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) Else Call nd_Courriel.Send(False) End If
End If
BCom_RetirerAffectationEmploye = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le bon de commande au conseiller sélectionné. ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoConseiller As Integer Dim v_NoConseillerIntial As Integer Dim v_Maj As Boolean
BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller = False
'Maj des dossiers du conseiller si le conseiller à changé. v_NoConseiller = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoConseiller",0) v_NoConseillerIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoConseillerInitial",0)
' Validation pour maj de dossier If v_NoConseiller = 0 Or v_NoConseillerIntial = v_NoConseiller Then BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller = True Exit Function End If
If v_NoConseillerIntial <> v_NoConseiller Then ' Transfert de dossier ( C = "Conseiller" ) If Not BCDo_TransfertDeDossierEmploye(pnd_BCom, v_NoConseiller, v_NoConseillerIntial, "C") Then BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller = False Exit Function End If v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_BCom.BCom_NoConseillerInitial = v_NoConseiller Call pnd_BCom.Save(True,False) End If
BCom_TransfertDossierConseiller = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le bon de commande d'un groupe à l'autre ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Grou40 As NotesView Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim v_NoPersAffecterIntial As Integer Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_Maj As Boolean
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = False
' Initialisations ' --------------- Call xSIEm_Initialisation
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","") v_NoPersAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",0)
If v_NomGroupeAffecter = v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = True Exit Function End If
a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) a_NoEmpMembresGroupe = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecter)
If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then 'Transfert de groupe à nouvelle groupe If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then If Not BCDo_TransfertDeDossierGroupe(pnd_BCom) Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
'Retirer du groupe (transfer à null) If v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, "", a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
'Ajouter dans dossiers du groupe (transfer de null à groupe) If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = "" Then If Not BCDo_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
v_Maj = True End If
' Retirer le document du dossier de l'employé(si transfert de employé vers groupe) If v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then
If Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial))) Then If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial) ,"A") Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_BCom.BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial = 0 pnd_BCom.BCom_NoPersAffecter = 0 pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial= v_NomGroupeAffecter Call pnd_BCom.Save(True,False) End If
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_AssignerAuteurs(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' Ce script mets les champs d'auteurs dans les "F_BCom".
On Error GoTo GererErreur BCom_AssignerAuteurs = False
Dim ni_Auteurs As NotesItem Dim ni_AuteursAdmin As NotesItem Dim v_UserName As String Dim v_ProprietaireBC As String Dim v_Affectation As String
' Initialisations Call BCom_Initialisations
' definir les champs Auteurs Set ni_Auteurs = pnd_BCom.GetFirstItem("Auteurs") If ni_Auteurs Is Nothing Then Set ni_Auteurs = New NotesItem(pnd_BCom, "Auteurs", "") End If Set ni_AuteursAdmin = pnd_BCom.GetFirstItem("AuteursAdmin") If ni_AuteursAdmin Is Nothing Then Set ni_AuteursAdmin = New NotesItem(pnd_BCom, "AuteursAdmin", "") End If
' ajouter le HistoUC (si necessaire) v_UserName = xVar(pnd_BCom, "HistoUC", gns_BCom.UserName)
If Not ni_Auteurs.Contains(v_UserName) Then Call ni_Auteurs.AppendToTextList(v_UserName) End If
v_ProprietaireBC = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_ProprietaireID", "")
If v_ProprietaireBC <> "" Then If Not ni_Auteurs.Contains(v_ProprietaireBC) Then Call ni_Auteurs.AppendToTextList(v_ProprietaireBC) End If End If
If xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","") <> "" Then v_Affectation = BCom_FormatterNomGroupe(xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","")) Else v_Affectation = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomPersAffecterID", "") End If
If v_Affectation <> "" Then If Not ni_Auteurs.Contains(v_Affectation) Then Call ni_Auteurs.AppendToTextList(v_Affectation) End If End If
' ajouter le role "Admin" (si necessaire) If Not ni_AuteursAdmin.Contains("[Admin]") Then Call ni_AuteursAdmin.AppendToTextList("[Admin]") End If If Not ni_AuteursAdmin.Contains("[AuteurTous]") Then Call ni_AuteursAdmin.AppendToTextList("[AuteurTous]") End If
' definir les deux champs comme "Authors" ni_Auteurs.IsAuthors = True ni_AuteursAdmin.IsAuthors = True
BCom_AssignerAuteurs = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_TransfertDossierAffectation(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer l'affectation du billet ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectation = False
'Transfert à employé If xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecter", 0) <> 0 And xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomPersAffecter", "") <> "" Or _ xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial", 0) <> 0 And xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") = "" Then If Not BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye(pnd_BCom) Then Exit Function End If
'Transfert à un groupe Elseif xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecter", "") <> "" Or _ xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial", "") <> "" Then If Not BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationGroupe(pnd_BCom) Then Exit Function End If End If
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectation = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Le bon de commande sélectionné. ' p_NoEmploye : Int. Le No de l'employe ' p_Type : String. Le type de dossier ( C = conseiller , A = affectation) ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant
BCom_TransfertDeDossierEmploye = False
Call BCDo_InfoDossier(Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Type , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
'Transfert le bon de commande If BCDo_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Type) Then BCom_TransfertDeDossierEmploye = True If p_NoEmployeInitial <> 0 Then If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(p_NoEmployeInitial), p_Type) Then
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
BCom_TransfertDeDossierEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
Else Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 17, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 16, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 17, "", v_Parametres), "", True) End If
Exit Function

Function BCom_RetirerAffectationGroupe(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument, p_NomGroupeAffecter As String, p_Commentaire As String, p_UserName As String) As Boolean '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retirer le groupe affecté au bon de commande
' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' p_NomGroupeAffecter ---> String. Le nom du groupe affecté au bon de commande ' p_Commentaire ---> String. Le commentaire saisi par l'utilisateur. '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_SendTo As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nd_Courriel As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem
BCom_RetirerAffectationGroupe = False
' Initialisations Call BCom_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_BCom.UserName End If
'Assigner commentaire v_Commentaire = "Action affectation retiré : " & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter","") & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire
'Assigner le affectation ' ---------------------- pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_BCom.BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_BCom, "" ,v_Commentaire, p_UserName, False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le bon de commande If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_BCom) Then
' Envoyer le courriel aux personnes concernées v_SendTo = BCom_FormatterNomGroupe(p_NomGroupeAffecter)
If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BCom.BCom_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
Set nd_Temp = New NotesDocument(gndb_BCom)
nd_Temp.Temp_Client = Evaluate({@If(@IsNull(BCom_ClientNoFmt) | BCom_ClientOccasionnel; BCom_ClientNom; @Trim(BCom_ClientNom1 + " " + BCom_ClientNom2) + " (" + BCom_ClientNoFmt + ")")}, pnd_BCom) nd_Temp.BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutCommentaires = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutCommentaires", "") nd_Temp.BCom_StatutDescFR = xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_StatutDescFR", "")
' Construire le courriel Set nd_Courriel = SICT_ConstruireMessage(nd_Temp, "A_WFBCom_R", "FR", v_SendTo, "", "", 0, "")
' Ajouter le lien vers l'affectation Set nrti = nd_Courriel.GetFirstItem("Body") Call nrti.AppendDocLink(pnd_BCom, "Bon de commande")
' Envoyer le courriel Call nd_Courriel.Send(False)
End If
BCom_RetirerAffectationGroupe = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_AssignerStatutTravail(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Statut As String, p_UserName As String) ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'assigner le champ BCom_StatutTravail ' Paramètres: pnd ---> Le document BC duquel provient l'information. Dim v_Langue As String Dim v_NoBonCommande As Long Dim v_NoBonCommandeFMT As String
Const c_NomTableStatut = "BCom_StatutBT"
' Initialisations BCom_AssignerStatutTravail = False Call BCom_Initialisations
If p_UserName = "" Then p_UserName = gns_BCom.UserName End If
' Valider le no de bon de commande v_NoBonCommandeFMT = xVar(pnd, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFMT", "") If v_NoBonCommandeFMT = "" Then ' TRAIEMENT ERREUR MANUELLE Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), GetThreadInfo(0), "NoBonCommande = 0", "", True) Exit Function End If
' Verifier si le statut a changé ' ------------------------------ If xVar(pnd, "BCom_StatutTravail", "") = p_Statut Then ' Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, GetThreadInfo(1), GetThreadInfo(0), "2- StatutTravail identique bdc: " & v_NoBonCommandeFMT & _ ' Chr(10) & |"BCom_StatutTravail" = | & xVar(pnd, "BCom_StatutTravail", "") & |p_Statut =| & p_statut, "", True) Exit Function End If
v_Langue = xLangue
' Assigner le nouveau statut ' -------------------------- pnd.BCom_StatutTravail = p_Statut pnd.BCom_StatutTravailIcone = xIcnTabl(p_Statut, c_NomTableStatut & v_Langue, True) pnd.BCom_StatutTravailDescFR = xDescTabl(p_Statut, c_NomTableStatut & "FR", True) pnd.BCom_StatutTravailDescEN = xDescTabl(p_Statut, c_NomTableStatut & "EN", True)

Function BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' --------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le bon de commande ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le bon de commande sélectionné. ' --------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim nv_Grou40 As notesview Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument
BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = False
' Initialisations
Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
If Not nv_Grou40 Is Nothing Then
Set nd_GrouAffecter = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecter, True)
If Not nd_GrouAffecter Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupe = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecter)
'Transfert le bon de commande If Isarray(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then If a_NoEmpMembresGroupe(Lbound(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe)) <> "" Then If BCom_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) If BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True End If End if Else
a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) If BCom_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If
BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If Else BCom_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If
End If
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye(pnd_BCom As NotesDocument) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le billet a l'employé en affectation. ' -------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoPersAffecterIntial As Integer Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim nd_GrouAffecter As Notesdocument Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nv_Grou40 As notesview Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_AjouterDossier As Boolean Dim v_Maj As Boolean
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False
' Initialisations '---------------- Call xSIEm_Initialisation
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
v_AjouterDossier = False
'Maj des dossiers du affecter à si le affecter à a changé. v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecter",0) v_NoPersAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial",0) v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_BCom,"BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
If v_NoPersAffecter = v_NoPersAffecterIntial Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = True Exit Function End If
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = BCDo_ExtraireMembresGroupe(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) End If
If v_NoPersAffecter <> v_NoPersAffecterIntial Then
'Transfert d'un employé à l'autre If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then If Not BCDo_TransfertDeDossierEmploye(pnd_BCom, v_NoPersAffecter, v_NoPersAffecterIntial, "A") Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
'Retirer du dossier de l'employé (transfer à null) If v_NoPersAffecter = 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then
If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial), "A") Then
Call BCDo_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 15, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
'Ajouter dans dossier de l'employé (transfer de null à employé) If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial = 0 Then
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then
If IsArray(a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then If IsNull(ArrayGetIndex(a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial, CStr(v_NoPersAffecter))) Then v_AjouterDossier = True End if Else If a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial <> CStr(v_NoPersAffecter) Then v_AjouterDossier = True End If End If
If v_AjouterDossier Then If Not BCDo_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter), "A") Then
Call BCDo_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_BCom, "BCom_NoBonCommandeFmt", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 17, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 16, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SIBDC", 17, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
Else If Not BCDo_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_BCom, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter), "A") Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
End If
v_Maj = True End If
'Si affectation précédente = groupe, retirer du groupe (transfer à null) If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then
If Not BCDo_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_BCom, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial), a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = False Exit Function End If v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_BCom.BCom_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = "" pnd_BCom.BCom_CodeGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_BCom.BCom_NoPersAffecterInitial = v_NoPersAffecter Call pnd_BCom.Save(True,False) End If
BCom_TransfertDossierAffectationEmploye = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_BCom, gc_Element_BCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
